parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page number of the resource relationship list. This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs to query. The value is in JSON array format and supports up to 20 items.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paged query. This is a deprecated field. Settings for paging are no longer supported.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The list of tags to query. The value is in JSON string format and contains up to 20 items.
